scripts.dev: sh -c 'pnpm --dir ../packages/shared build && pnpm prisma:generate && { pnpm --dir ../packages/shared watch & shared_pid=$!; trap "kill $shared_pid" EXIT INT TERM; nest start --watch; }'
scripts.worker:dev: sh -c 'pnpm --dir ../packages/shared build && pnpm prisma:generate && { pnpm --dir ../packages/shared watch & shared_pid=$!; trap "kill $shared_pid" EXIT INT TERM; nest start --watch --entryFile worker/main; }'
scripts.build: pnpm --dir ../packages/shared build && pnpm prisma:generate && nest build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir ../packages/shared build && pnpm prisma:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
